# Icons

Generated by `npm run icons` from the `lucide` package (ISC licence): 24x24 SVG, `stroke="currentColor"`,
`stroke-width="1.5"`, round caps. Do not hand-edit generated files: edit the `ICONS` map in `scripts/icons.mjs`.

## Generated files
arrow-right, plus, close, check, phone, mail, map-pin, menu,
service-website, service-starter, service-shop, service-search, service-social, service-marketing, service-data, service-maintenance,
plus `sprite.svg` and `LUCIDE-LICENSE.txt`.

## Added by hand (never overwritten)
| File | What |
|---|---|
| `whatsapp.svg` | Official WhatsApp glyph, single colour, `fill="currentColor"`. `npm run icons` also copies it into `sprite.svg` as `#whatsapp` |
| `social-<name>.svg` | Only for social profiles that really exist (e.g. `social-facebook.svg`). Copied into the sprite the same way |
| `logo.svg` | When the logo is final |

Naming: lowercase, hyphens, no spaces. Services start with `service-`, social logos with `social-`.
